# orchestration_cluster_role_member_user (Resource)

Assigns a user to a Camunda cluster role

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orchestration_cluster_role" "deployer" {
  role_id = "deployer"
  name    = "Deployer"
}

resource "orchestration_cluster_user" "alice" {
  username = "alice"
  name     = "Alice Smith"
  email    = "alice@example.com"
  password = var.alice_password
}

resource "orchestration_cluster_role_member_user" "alice_deployer" {
  role_id = orchestration_cluster_role.deployer.id
  user_id = orchestration_cluster_user.alice.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) The ID of the role.
- `user_id` (String) The username of the user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID of the assignment (percent-encoded `role_id/user_id`). Also used as the import ID: `terraform import orchestration_cluster_role_member_user.example <role_id>/<user_id>`, with each component percent-encoded if it contains a `/`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import orchestration_cluster_role_member_user.alice_deployer deployer/alice
```
